findings.detail: The two-regen flow and a packaged-closeout assertion now exist, but the assertion still permits a package closeout up to 8 commits behind HEAD and compares against HEAD, not the digest's declared commit. The current package manifest (declared f79d786e) hashes closeout/FINAL_RESPONSE.json = 75e3ef6..., which names 7c447ac (the prior records commit), not f79d786e; the working-tree closeout names f79d786e. The delivered package therefore still embeds a previous-cycle closeout.
evidence: review-package/MANIFEST.sha256:314 (closeout/FINAL_RESPONSE.json = 75e3ef6...); the file at f79d786e names commit 7c447ac
closeout/FINAL_RESPONSE.json at HEAD names f79d786e (sha256 fbfc5bac...)
automation/validation/verify_delivery.sh:55-70 (assertion allows distance <= 8 and compares to HEAD, not the declared commit)
CHANGELOG.md:12-14 claims REL-P3-003 fixed by the two-regen flow
findings.remediation: Regenerate the closeout before building the package (or rebuild the manifest after) and assert packaged-closeout commit == declared commit; tighten the distance from 8 to 0.
findings.note: Partially fixed: assertion added, but the shipped package still lags the declared commit and the gate permits it.

findings.title: The review pack omits the entire SBOM/vuln set but the package manifest lists it; pack fidelity still reports PASS with 51 unexplained entries
findings.detail: The review package now ships sbom/ (owner decision D2, 2026-10-15), so review-package/MANIFEST.sha256 contains 56 sbom files. make-repomix.sh still excludes sbom/*.cdx.json and sbom/vuln/** from the repomix pack. pack_fidelity.py therefore writes 51 'not-in-pack (unexpected; investigate)' rows, but returns 0 because it only fails on content mismatches, and verify_delivery.sh treats that as pack_fidelity_verdict=PASS. A pack-only reviewer cannot see the SBOM/vuln set the manifest claims, and the unresolved rows are not surfaced as a failure.
evidence: automation/validation/verify_delivery.sh:42-50 (PASS from pack_fidelity return code; no not-in-pack assertion)
automation/validation/build_review_package.sh:51-53 (sbom set ships in the package since 2026-10-15)
PACK_NOT_INCLUDED.txt last changed 2026-10-15 (commit a0ac9003), so the artifact is stale across the later publication cycles
findings.remediation: Add the sbom ignore patterns to KNOWN_PACK_EXCLUSIONS (or include sbom in the pack), fail on any 'unexpected' not-in-pack entry, and regenerate PACK_NOT_INCLUDED.txt in verify_delivery.sh. If the pack intentionally cannot carry 56 MB of SBOM, record that as a dated disposition and keep the package manifest authoritative.
findings.note: New P2. Distinct from INV-P3-002 (the artifact regression): this is the systemic mismatch + fail-open gate introduced when SBOMs started shipping in the package.

findings.title: Review package omits the Falcon Console source and the root LICENSE/NOTICE/VERSION/CHANGELOG files
findings.detail: build_review_package.sh copies only docs ledgers closeout compose config bootstrap automation ci pins mct sbom plus evidence and three root files (REPOSITORY.md, README.md, AGENTS.md). Two omissions follow. (1) The Falcon Console (console/, 19 tracked files including auth.py, sso_gateway.py, api/server.py, actions_broker.py and tests) is now the product's root UI/API but is never copied; PACKAGE_MANIFEST.sha256 has zero './console/' entries (the only console matches are ./automation/console/resolve_sources.sh and ./config/console/roles.yaml). (2) The root LICENSE, NOTICE, VERSION, CHANGELOG.md and TESTING.md files are also absent from the manifest. A reviewer receiving the declared package cannot inspect or rebuild the console and does not receive the GPLv2 license text or the third-party NOTICE that the repository now advertises.
evidence: automation/validation/build_review_package.sh:34-39 (copy list: docs ledgers closeout compose config bootstrap automation ci pins mct sbom; root files only REPOSITORY.md/README.md/AGENTS.md)
git ls-files console -> 19 files, including console/auth.py, console/sso_gateway.py, console/api/server.py, console/actions_broker.py and console/tests/
PACKAGE_MANIFEST.sha256: 0 entries for ./LICENSE, ./NOTICE, ./VERSION, ./CHANGELOG.md, ./TESTING.md, although README.md:127-131 advertises LICENSE/NOTICE
docs/runbooks/CONSOLE_PHASE0.md:3-5 (Console is live at the public root since 2026-10-21)
findings.remediation: Add console/ and the root LICENSE/NOTICE/VERSION/CHANGELOG/TESTING files to the package copy list, rebuild the review package/manifest/digest, and add a gate that every tracked first-party top-level source file/directory is represented in the package manifest (allowlist the generated/delivery dirs explicitly).
findings.note: New P2. This is a package-completeness gap, not a repomix-pack omission: the pack includes console/, the formal review package does not; the missing LICENSE/NOTICE also undermines the HYGIENE-P3-001 closure for the delivered artifact.

findings.title: Main is unbound and red after the Kestrel SSO merges: publication equality fails at db8c409 and the package still declares f79d786e
findings.detail: PACKAGE_DIGEST.txt declares repository/closeout/delivered commit f79d786e (2026-11-03). Seven commits have landed since, including security/SSO changes (6c923cd8, 93a31cc6, merge ba4bf8b4/db8c409). The repository validate workflow on the db8c409 push failed (run 42164078378, 2026-11-06): 'FAIL publication equality ... commits after the declared commit touch only publication/test files (93a31cc6:config/traefik/dynamic.yml; 93a31cc6:console/sso_gateway.py; ... 6c923cd8:bootstrap/98-console.sh; ...)'. The topic-branch allowance only applies to pull_request events, so PR CI can be green while main stays red until a rebind; no rebind followed the merges. The delivered package therefore predates the Kestrel SSO cutover.
evidence: git rev-list --count f79d786e..db8c409 -> 7 commits, including 6c923cd8 and 93a31cc6 (Kestrel SSO) and the merge commits
GitHub Actions run 42164078378 (push, db8c409, 2026-11-06): check 'validate' failure; log line 'FAIL publication equality ... commits after the declared commit touch ...'
check_publication_equality.py at db8c409: FAIL (commits after declared commit touch source files)
findings.remediation: Rebind the publication chain at the post-Kestrel commit (build package, regenerate closeout, publish digest) before/at merge of source waves, and add a post-merge/main check that fails fast when the declared commit is behind source commits; consider requiring the rebind as part of the merge.
findings.note: New P2. The gate is honestly strict and detects the drift; the defect is the process leaving main unbound and red after a security-relevant merge.

findings.title: The mTLS ingest migration left three plaintext HTTP validation paths that can no longer exercise replay/DLQ ingress
findings.detail: The aggregator's edge_ingest source now requires mutual TLS (verify_certificate: true), and the probe sink presents a client certificate. Three live validation scripts still POST plain http://vector-aggregator:6000/ without certs: phase4_data_checks.sh (the replay test, expects events to be ingested), probe_pipeline_test.sh (the dead-letter test, expects the DLQ to grow), and phase7_security_checks.sh (old-credential rejection). Against the TLS listener the plaintext requests fail at the handshake, so the replay and DLQ checks either fail or pass for the wrong reason; the security regression suite no longer tests the deployed ingress.
evidence: evidence/raw/REVIEW-FIX/20261014T232947Z_ingest-mtls.out: handshake failure without a client certificate
findings.remediation: Update the three scripts to use https with the ingest CA/client cert from /srv/falcon/secrets/vector-ingest (or run the request from the probe container), and add an offline fixture asserting the plaintext path is rejected.
findings.note: New P2. The mTLS migration itself is sound (ARCH-P2-003 verified-fixed); its negative/positive tests were not migrated.
